protocol.name: arxiv-publication-year-base4-v1

source.feature_protocol: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 mean-pool normalized; weights from frozen GraphCLIP checkpoint

protocol.access: current-stage legal training nodes and own frozen synthetic prefix
protocol.edge_time_assumption: An observed final-graph edge becomes available when both endpoints have arrived; no edge-event timestamps are available.
protocol.stream: publication-year arrivals with recurring classes; not disjoint new-class tasks
protocol.prompt_taxonomy: fixed known 40-category metadata; no future node labels in constructors
protocol.full_cpu_source: offline harness holds data for slicing; not a physical deletion implementation
protocol.evaluation: predeclared chronological extension on previously inspected masks; not new blind data
protocol.repair_reason: Verified float64 normalization plus larger solver cap 16384; tolerance, objectives and 30 construction updates unchanged

audit.objective: Q-derived X/text/topology with multimodal gradient and propagation matching

distribution_matching.target_scope: current-delta rows of legal reference one-hop messages
distribution_matching.synthetic_scope: current slots after materialized synthetic one-hop propagation
distribution_matching.reduction: sum over classes/features, mean over random Encoder bank

joint_pair_distribution.kernel: product of fixed normalized ReLU random-feature kernels
joint_pair_distribution.reference_scope: current-delta legal one-hop message and exactly materializable text candidates
joint_pair_distribution.shuffling_scope: new target statistic only; candidate pool, initialization and source IDs unchanged

audit.topology_operator: binary simple undirected + one self loop; Student normalization
